crossRefs.note: You came near and stood under the mountain. The mountain burned with fire to the heart of the sky, with darkness…
Then Solomon said, “Yahweh has said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.
But I have built you a house and home, a place for you to dwell in forever.”
Smoke went out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.
Clouds and darkness are around him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.
The people stayed at a distance, and Moses came near to the thick darkness where God was.
and Yahweh said to Moses, “Tell Aaron your brother not to come at just any time into the Most Holy Place within the…

Most certainly you are a God who has hidden yourself, God of Israel, the Savior.’ ”

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: Then Solomon said, “Yahweh has said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.
